text: validate.py B4 (build leg) first found one error: the B4b manifest entry carried the reader count only inside each arm, with no n_agents at the top. Superseded, not edited: out/_analysis/b4b_manifest2.py appended entry 13, a copy with n_agents 2 (two fresh readers per item in each arm; 68 reader sessions an arm) and 'supersedes' naming entry 12, which stays in the file. Re-run: 0 errors, 8 warnings, all one shape: a packet file 'mentions a ruling'. I read all 13 lines: G01.md (T3-??? must_show 'jokes about ruling') and G14.md (T3-162's 'a host ruling on requests', six lines) are the frozen scheme's words, served byte for byte at B3; S05-02, S05-10, S05-13, S05-17, S05-19 and S05-33 hold coders' labels and notes and participants' words ('ruling out Reddit Gold', 'an unresolved search for responsibility', 'ruling that logos are art'). None speaks of my rulings; the scheme is frozen and the coders' words are served as written, so the warnings stand as read.
Correction to the previous line: the G01.md line that mentions 'jokes about ruling' is T3-093's must_show ('playing with granted moderator powers', rare). I had written its id as a placeholder.

Closing B4b at --cut packets-out. The blind sample is drawn and built once for both arms: 500 items (stratum U 250 uniform from the analysed set; stratum A 250 from the ruled items U did not take; seed 20261013), 34 packets in fleet ids under 50 KB and 15 items each, the shared pages byte for byte B3's, RETURN-B4.md as at B3 with rule 0 in the contract's current words, run_manifest.json entry 13 declaring arm 1 (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash x2, the route arm.json sets for B4) and arm 2 (OpenAI gpt-6-astra medium x2, the Codex orchestrator on J's computer), never pooled, no Claude reader. validate.py B4: 0 errors, 8 warnings (the frozen scheme's and coders' own words, read). notes-B4.md holds the declarations made before the draw, the draw, the build, the doubts and the validator's report; the head is rewritten (2,855 words). The account the check will test: whether strangers holding only the frozen scheme reach the settled line, in the ordinary item (U) and in my rulings (A); my expectation from the adjudication is that A falls below U, most on G20 and G21, where the scheme's sentences do not say whose work they mean. Next: the dispatch (not mine), then the check leg.

B4b-p2 opened (the PI at 14:49Z; J at 16:43 Berlin: 'draw other 18'). Declared in notes-B4.md before the draw ('Stratum R, the other 18 unresolved items'): frame = the 185 unresolved rulings not in sample-B4.jsonl (167), sorted by room and theme id; 18 drawn uniformly without replacement with Random('20261013:R'), served in the order of Random('20261013:R-order'); sibling record out/sample-B4-R.jsonl (orders 501-518), sample-B4.jsonl untouched; no redraw. R is diagnostic and apart: per arm, over 18 items and 36 readings, the readers' agreement with each other (Jaccard, primary, alpha by B2's definition), whether primaries meet, and whether fresh placements fall among reading A's, reading B's and my B1's placements or outside; the same for the 18 unresolved already in U (3) and A (15), by stratum, never pooled; no reading changes a ruling. Packets under the same section 10 rules, S05-35 onward, beside the 34, which stay as built; MANIFEST.json gains entries only (old copy kept); run_manifest.json gains an entry superseding entry 13. Next: the draw.

Stratum R drawn as declared (out/_analysis/b4b_sample_R.py --write; seed 20261013, streams '20261013:R' and '20261013:R-order'): out/sample-B4-R.jsonl, 18 lines, orders 501-518, sha256 1d0c75a6...; record out/_analysis/b4b_sample_R.json. Frame: 167 unresolved rulings not in sample-B4.jsonl (the other 18 are already drawn, 15 in A and 3 in U, listed in the record). R: 18 items over 18 rooms; class 3 9, class 4 8, class 5 1; taxonomy scheme-ambiguous 13, author-disagrees 5 (class 5 bare titles); no gold or pilot item. sample-B4.jsonl unchanged (sha256 2fe441cd...). No redraw. Next: the R packets.

Correction to the previous line: of R's five author-disagrees rulings, one is a class 5 bare title (kuwait t09); the other four are class 4 items where the lone-B1 rule left my theme out and the readers' test took nothing (touhou t18, shield t07, austria t12, yogscast t11). R by packet of origin: 1 seven, 2 two, 4 three, 6 four, 7 two (out/_analysis/b4b_R_list.py, read-only, lists each item's reading A, reading B and my B1 for the check's diagnostic).

Stratum R's packets built into out/_packets-B4/ beside the 34 (out/_analysis/b4b_packets_R.py --write, the B4b builder's renderer, brief, end line and checks): S05-35 (8 items, 8,204 bytes) and S05-36 (10 items, 5,947 bytes), the cut chosen for the smaller largest packet; fleet ids only, no room-id-like string in participants' words. Before writing, the 34 packets matched their MANIFEST sha256 and no S05-35 existed. MANIFEST.json kept first as out/_analysis/packets-B4_MANIFEST_before_R.json, then given the two new entries only: 36 entries, 518 lines due. Order record out/_analysis/b4b_order_R.json. b4b_packets_check2.py (new; the B4b check over both sample records, orders 1-518, plus B4b's 34 entries unchanged): 0 errors; 518 items served once each in order, each translating back to its room; the R packets add no line with a word that could hint at a decision (the 22 such lines are B4b's, read at B4b). A coder's note in S05-36 says a single-code theme 'preserves rather than resolves that ambiguity': the coder's words about the coder's own grouping, served as at B3. Next: the run_manifest.json entry.

run_manifest.json entry 14 (stage B4, leg B4b-p2; out/_analysis/b4b_manifest3.py) supersedes entry 13 and stays beside it: 518 items in 36 packets (8 to 15 items, 5,947 to 49,994 bytes), stratum R named (18 from the 167 unresolved rulings not in sample-B4.jsonl, J 16:43 Berlin, diagnostic, never pooled), seed streams '20261013:R' and ':R-order', the R sample's sha256, n_agents 2 (72 reader sessions an arm), 1,000 settled-line comparisons an arm for U and A and R's 36 readings an arm as the readers' own agreement and convergence. Both arms as declared at B4b. Next: notes-B4.md, validate.py B4, the head, done.sh B4 --cut packets-out.

Closing B4b-p2 at --cut packets-out. Stratum R is drawn and built as J's 'draw other 18' was read by the PI: 18 unresolved items not in sample-B4.jsonl (frame 167; seed 20261013, streams ':R' and ':R-order'; out/sample-B4-R.jsonl), diagnostic and apart; packets S05-35 and S05-36 beside the 34, which stay as built; MANIFEST.json 36 entries, 518 lines due (the old manifest kept); run_manifest.json entry 14 supersedes 13; both arms read the new packets. b4b_packets_check2.py 0 errors; validate.py B4 0 errors, 8 warnings (the scheme's and coders' own words, read at B4b; the R packets add none). notes-B4.md holds R's declaration made before the draw, the draw with each item's earlier placements, the build, two doubts (R packets hold only thin unresolved items; 18 is few) and the validator's report; the head is updated (2,973 words). In 8 of R's 18 items both B3 readers agreed and I found their test takes nothing: there fresh readers converging would most test my reading. Next: the dispatch (not mine), then the check leg.
